title: Ebola Outbreak in Congo Spreads Faster Than Ever Before
subtitle: Health officials report that the current crisis is moving at record speed, with over 1,000 deaths recorded in just two months.

summary.en: A new Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 1,000 deaths in record time. This crisis is spreading three times faster than the major 2014-2016 epidemic. The virus involved is a rare variant that currently lacks approved vaccines or medical treatments. Most cases are concentrated in the eastern region of the country near the border with Uganda. Health officials warn that the peak of the outbreak may still be ahead.
summary.zh: 剛果民主共和國爆發的新一波伊波拉疫情，以破紀錄的速度達到一千人死亡。這場危機的傳播速度比二零一四至二零一六年的重大疫情快了三倍。此次涉及的病毒是一種罕見變異株，目前缺乏核准的疫苗或醫療治療方式。大多數病例集中在該國鄰近烏干達邊界的東部地區。衛生官員警告，疫情高峰可能尚未到來。

paragraphs.en: The Ebola outbreak currently affecting the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached a sad milestone. According to data from Congo's Ministry of Health, the virus has now caused more than 1,000 deaths. This number is significant because the virus has reached this level nearly three times faster than the 2014-2016 Ebola epidemic, which was previously considered the worst in history.
paragraphs.zh: 目前影響剛果民主共和國的伊波拉病毒疫情已達到一個令人遺憾的里程碑。根據剛果衛生部的數據，該病毒目前已造成超過一千人死亡。這個數字之所以顯著，是因為病毒達到此規模的速度，比先前被認為是史上最嚴重的二零一四至二零一六年伊波拉疫情快了近三倍。

paragraphs.en: Since the current outbreak was officially declared on May 15, officials have recorded 2,536 confirmed cases. In comparison, the 2014-2016 outbreak took eight months to reach 1,000 deaths. This year, the same number of deaths occurred in just over two months. This makes the current situation the fastest-spreading outbreak of the disease ever recorded.
paragraphs.zh: 自從目前這波疫情於五月十五日正式宣布以來，官員已記錄到兩千五百三十六起確診病例。相較之下，二零一四至二零一六年的疫情花了八個月才達到一千人死亡。今年，同樣的死亡人數在短短兩個多月內就發生了。這使得目前的情況成為有史以來記錄到傳播速度最快的疾病疫情。

paragraphs.en: Experts from the World Health Organization explain that Ebola is caused by a group of different viruses. The current crisis is caused by the Bundibugyo virus. This is a rare variant of the disease, and importantly, there are currently no approved vaccines or medical treatments available to fight it. In contrast, the 2014-2016 outbreak was caused by the Ebola virus, which is more common but also very dangerous. The CDC notes that the Ebola virus can be fatal in up to 90% of cases if patients do not receive proper care.
paragraphs.zh: 世界衛生組織（World Health Organization）的專家解釋，伊波拉是由一群不同的病毒所引起。目前的危機是由邦迪布焦病毒（Bundibugyo virus）所導致。這是一種罕見的變異病毒，重要的是，目前尚無核准的疫苗或醫療方法可用來對抗它。相比之下，二零一四至二零一六年的疫情是由伊波拉病毒所引起，該病毒較為常見但也非常危險。美國疾病管制與預防中心（CDC）指出，如果患者未獲得適當照護，伊波拉病毒的致死率最高可達百分之九十。

paragraphs.en: At this time, the outbreak is mostly limited to Congo, specifically within five provinces in the eastern part of the country. These areas are close to the border with Uganda, and a small number of cases have been reported in that neighboring nation. While the 2014-2016 outbreak spread widely across Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone—and even reached parts of Europe and the United States—the current situation remains largely contained within the region.
paragraphs.zh: 目前，疫情主要侷限於剛果，具體範圍在該國東部的五個省份。這些地區鄰近烏干達邊界，且該鄰國已通報了少數病例。雖然二零一四至二零一六年的疫情在幾內亞、賴比瑞亞和獅子山共和國廣泛傳播，甚至波及歐洲和美國的部分地區，但目前的情況仍大致控制在該區域內。

paragraphs.en: Health officials are concerned about the high death rate, which is currently at 40%. According to official reports, many of these deaths happen because patients wait too long to seek medical help after they start feeling sick. When people report their symptoms late, it is much harder for doctors to provide the care needed to save their lives. The 2014-2016 outbreak had a similar fatality rate of about 39.6%, but it lasted for three years and put a massive strain on health systems across multiple countries.
paragraphs.zh: 衛生官員對目前高達百分之四十的死亡率感到擔憂。根據官方報告，許多死亡案例是因為患者在開始感到不適後，等待太久才尋求醫療協助。當民眾太晚通報症狀時，醫師要提供挽救生命所需的照護就困難得多。二零一四至二零一六年的疫情也有相似的致死率，約為百分之三十九點六，但該次疫情持續了三年，並對多國的醫療系統造成了巨大壓力。

paragraphs.en: Looking ahead, experts believe the worst may not be over yet. Officials have not yet identified 'patient zero,' the first person to catch the virus, which makes it harder to track how the disease is moving. Furthermore, most new cases are coming from people who were not previously being watched by health teams. There were also early delays in identifying exactly which variant of the virus was causing the sickness, which slowed down the initial response.
paragraphs.zh: 展望未來，專家認為最糟糕的情況可能尚未結束。官員尚未確認「零號病人」，即首位感染病毒的人，這使得追蹤疾病傳播路徑變得更加困難。此外，大多數的新增病例來自先前未受醫療團隊監控的人員。早期在確認究竟是哪種病毒變異株導致疾病時也出現了延誤，這減緩了最初的應對速度。

paragraphs.en: Because of these factors, health organizations are working hard to monitor the situation. The rapid speed of this outbreak serves as a reminder of how quickly infectious diseases can move in certain conditions. For now, the focus remains on stopping the spread in the eastern provinces and encouraging people to seek medical attention as soon as they feel unwell. As the situation develops, international health groups continue to watch the border areas closely to prevent the virus from moving further into neighboring countries.
paragraphs.zh: 由於這些因素，衛生組織正努力監控局勢。此次疫情的快速蔓延提醒了我們，傳染病在特定條件下能以多快的速度傳播。目前，重點仍放在阻止東部省份的擴散，並鼓勵民眾在感到不適時儘速就醫。隨著局勢發展，國際衛生團體持續密切關注邊境地區，以防止病毒進一步擴散至鄰國。

keyTerms.definitionEn: An important event or stage in the development of something.
keyTerms.noteZh: 此詞常指物理上的里程碑，這裡比喻為疫情發展中的重大標誌點。文中：The Ebola outbreak currently affecting the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached a sad milestone.

keyTerms.definitionEn: A force or pressure that causes difficulty or damage.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作動詞（拉緊），這裡作名詞，指對醫療系統造成的沉重負擔。文中：The 2014-2016 outbreak had a similar fatality rate of about 39.6%, but it lasted for three years and put a massive strain on health systems across multiple countries.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To monitor or keep under observation.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「看」，這裡指醫療團隊對病患進行追蹤與監控。文中：Furthermore, most new cases are coming from people who were not previously being watched by health teams.

quiz.question: How does the speed of the current Ebola outbreak compare to the 2014-2016 epidemic?

options.A: It is moving at the same speed as the previous outbreak.
options.B: It reached 1,000 deaths nearly three times faster than the previous outbreak.
options.C: It took eight months to reach 1,000 deaths, which is slower than before.
options.D: It has caused fewer deaths in total compared to the 2014-2016 epidemic.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第一段，目前的疫情達到 1,000 例死亡的速度比 2014-2016 年的疫情快了近三倍。選項 A 錯誤，因為文章強調兩者速度差異巨大；選項 C 混淆了數據，2014-2016 年的疫情才花了八個月達到此數據，而非現況；選項 D 雖然目前總死亡人數較少，但題目問的是「速度」而非總人數，故不正確。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about the difficulty of controlling the current Ebola outbreak?

options.A: The outbreak is easily contained because it is limited to five provinces.
options.B: The lack of an identified 'patient zero' makes it easier to track the virus's origin.
options.C: The virus is spreading in ways that challenge current monitoring and tracking efforts.
options.D: The fatality rate is significantly higher than any previously recorded Ebola outbreak.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第六段，由於無法找到「零號病人」且許多新病例來自未被監控的人群，導致追蹤病毒動向變得困難。選項 A 錯誤，雖然目前範圍有限，但文章並未說「容易」控制；選項 B 邏輯相反，找不到源頭反而更難追蹤；選項 D 錯誤，文章提到 2014-2016 年的死亡率為 39.6%，與目前的 40% 相差不大，並非「顯著更高」。

quiz.question: In the fifth paragraph, what does the word 'strain' mean in the context of 'put a massive strain on health systems'?

options.A: A physical injury to a muscle or body part.
options.B: A specific genetic variant of a virus.
options.C: A heavy burden or pressure that causes distress.
options.D: A process of filtering or separating substances.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。在此語境中，'strain' 指的是對醫療系統造成的沉重負擔或壓力。選項 A 是該詞的常見生理意義（拉傷），但在文中不適用；選項 B 雖然文中其他地方提到病毒變異（variant），但此處的 strain 是指壓力而非生物學術語；選項 D 的意思為過濾，與句意完全不符。

quiz.question: What is the primary message of the article regarding the current Ebola situation?

options.A: The current Ebola outbreak is less dangerous because it is limited to one country.
options.B: Medical experts have successfully identified the virus and are treating all patients.
options.C: The rapid spread and unique challenges of this outbreak require urgent attention and vigilance.
options.D: The current outbreak is identical to the 2014-2016 epidemic in terms of its global impact.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章整體旨在探討此次疫情的快速傳播特性、缺乏疫苗的挑戰以及追蹤困難，提醒公眾與相關單位需高度警戒。選項 A 錯誤，文章強調其危險性；選項 B 錯誤，文中提到缺乏有效疫苗且治療困難；選項 D 錯誤，文章明確指出此次疫情在傳播速度與地理範圍上與過去不同，並非完全相同。
